protocol.order: Cyclic across four modes by repetition and case; one untimed full product first
protocol.direct32_arithmetic: Round features once to FP32; fixed increasing feature loop subtract/square/add in FP32; multiply FP32 coefficient and exp in FP32; promote tile then FP64 dot with original vector
protocol.baseline_arithmetic: Reproduces existing cdist64, Gram32-acc64 and cdist64-exp32-acc64 formulas; same per-mode8/12-byte tile budgeting.
protocol.interpretation: Operator consistency, dense stability oracle and standalone product cost only; no inner/full solver, total-memory or efficiency claim.
